newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Burundi's Buyoya congratulates Kabila on takeover.
newsitem.headline: Burundi's Buyoya congratulates Kabila on takeover.

text.p: Burundi's military leader Pierre Buyoya has congratulated Zaire's self-declared president Laurent Kabila for his military takeover of the country.

"We wish to present to you (Kabila) our very sincere congratulations on the occasion of your accession to the supreme office of your country," Buyoya said in a message broadcast on state-run radio Burundi on Sunday.

"The Republic of Burundi will appreciate the revival of bilateral and multidimensional relations with your country as well as the revival of the Economic Community of the Countries of the Great Lakes," Buyoya's said.
Ousted Zaire president Mobutu Sese Seko accused ethnic Tutsi Buyoya of supporting the rebellion which began on Zaire's Burundi border. Buyoya denied the charge.

African states including Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa and Tanzania have been quick to recognize Kabila's Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire which took the capital Kinshasa on Saturday.
